extracted_requirements.title: Continuous Current Sensing Dynamic Range & Accuracy
extracted_requirements.description: The pack current sensor shall measure continuous current between -600.0 A (regen) and +600.0 A (discharge) with total error <= 0.5% full scale.

extracted_requirements.title: Front-End ASIC High-Voltage Standoff Limit
extracted_requirements.description: The BMS front-end cell acquisition circuitry shall withstand common-mode voltages up to 1000.0 V DC continuously without dielectric breakdown.

extracted_requirements.title: Active Cell Balancing Balancing Current
extracted_requirements.description: The BMS active cell balancing subsystem shall deliver a minimum balancing current of 300.0 mA per cell during top-balancing mode.

extracted_requirements.title: Secondary Redundant Over-Temperature Hardware Cutoff
extracted_requirements.description: A completely independent hardwired secondary analog thermal comparator shall trigger the HV pyro-switch if pack temperature exceeds 95.0°C.

extracted_requirements.title: High-Voltage Isolation Loss Detection Response Time
extracted_requirements.description: When chassis isolation resistance drops below 100.0 Ω/V, the insulation monitor shall assert the ISO_FAULT signal within 2.0 seconds.

extracted_requirements.title: Acoustic Gas Venting Detection Sensor Baseline
extracted_requirements.description: The battery enclosure acoustic sensor shall detect high-pressure cell venting acoustic signatures within 50 ms of membrane burst.

extracted_requirements.title: HV Interlock Loop (HVIL) Pulse Width Modulation Diagnostic
extracted_requirements.description: The HVIL circuit shall operate on a 1.0 kHz ± 10 Hz PWM signal and detect an open-loop condition within 5.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Inverter Phase Overcurrent Hardware Shutdown
extracted_requirements.description: The traction inverter gate driver shall detect phase overcurrent exceeding 650.0 A peak and shut down all SiC power switches within 1.5 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: DC-Link Capacitor Voltage Discharge Time
extracted_requirements.description: Upon active discharge command, the inverter active discharge circuit shall reduce DC-link voltage from 800.0 V to below 60.0 V in less than 5.0 seconds.

extracted_requirements.title: Inverter Operating Efficiency Map
extracted_requirements.description: The traction inverter efficiency shall exceed 97.5% across motor torque range of 50.0 Nm to 350.0 Nm from 2000 rpm to 10000 rpm.

extracted_requirements.title: Resolver Position Sensor Angle Tracking Jitter
extracted_requirements.description: The motor resolver-to-digital converter shall track rotor electrical angle up to 20000 rpm with angular error less than ±0.25 degrees across -40°C to +105°C.

extracted_requirements.title: SiC MOSFET Junction Temperature Derating Limit
extracted_requirements.description: The inverter control unit shall allow maximum continuous power output with SiC MOSFET junction temperature up to 175.0°C.

extracted_requirements.title: Phase Current Measurement Sensor Bandwidth
extracted_requirements.description: Inverter phase current Hall sensors shall have a minimum -3dB analog bandwidth of 250.0 kHz.

extracted_requirements.title: Emergency Traction Torque Derating on CAN Loss
extracted_requirements.description: If torque request CAN message is lost for greater than 100 ms, the inverter shall ramp output torque to 0.0 Nm within 200 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Inverter Coolant Flow Rate vs Thermal Resistance
extracted_requirements.description: At coolant flow rate of 10.0 L/min (50/50 water-glycol at 65°C), the inverter cold plate thermal resistance Rth_j-c shall not exceed 0.045 K/W.

extracted_requirements.title: Space Vector PWM Harmonic Distortion (THD)
extracted_requirements.description: Under rated 150 kW load, total phase current harmonic distortion (THD) shall not exceed 3.0%.

extracted_requirements.title: Field Oriented Control (FOC) Flux Weakening Stability
extracted_requirements.description: The inverter FOC algorithm shall maintain stable demagnetization current control without torque oscillations during deep flux weakening.

extracted_requirements.title: HV-to-LV DC-DC Output Voltage Regulation
extracted_requirements.description: The bidirectional DC-DC converter shall regulate 12V output voltage to 13.80 V ± 0.15 V under step load changes from 10.0 A to 200.0 A in less than 500 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: DC-DC Converter Dielectric Withstand Isolation
extracted_requirements.description: Galvanic isolation barrier between HV (800V) and LV (12V) side shall withstand 3.0 kV AC rms at 50 Hz for 60 seconds with leakage current < 1.0 mA.

extracted_requirements.title: DC-DC Conversion Efficiency Across Load Profile
extracted_requirements.description: DC-DC conversion efficiency shall exceed 94.0% for all output power levels between 300.0 W and 3000.0 W at Vin = 650 V.

extracted_requirements.title: 12V Output Voltage Ripple and Noise
extracted_requirements.description: Output peak-to-peak voltage ripple on the 12V bus shall not exceed 100.0 mVpp across temperature range of -40°C to +85°C.

extracted_requirements.title: Low-Voltage Output Continuous Current Rating
extracted_requirements.description: The DC-DC converter shall deliver continuous output current of at least 250.0 A at 14.0 V at ambient temperature up to 65.0°C.

extracted_requirements.title: HV Input Under-Voltage Lockout Threshold
extracted_requirements.description: The DC-DC converter shall shut down and enter safe standby when HV input voltage drops below 350.0 V DC.

extracted_requirements.title: Low-Voltage Reverse Polarity Protection
extracted_requirements.description: The 12V battery terminal connection shall withstand continuous reverse polarity of -14.0 V for 60 seconds without blown fuse or component damage.

extracted_requirements.title: Over-Current Hiccup Mode Recovery Period
extracted_requirements.description: When short-circuit occurs on 12V output, the converter shall limit current in hiccup mode and attempt auto-restart every 500 ms ± 50 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Conducted Voltage Transients Suppression (ISO 7637-2)

extracted_requirements.description: The thermal management controller shall regulate battery inlet coolant temperature to 25.0°C ± 2.0°C under 5.0 kW pack heat load.

extracted_requirements.title: HV Electric AC Compressor Speed Control
extracted_requirements.description: The electric AC compressor inverter shall control compressor speed between 1000 rpm and 8500 rpm with speed error < ±50 rpm.

extracted_requirements.title: Cabin Heat Pump Heating Capacity at Low Ambient
extracted_requirements.description: At ambient temperature of -15.0°C, the heat pump shall deliver at least 4.5 kW thermal heating capacity into the cabin air loop.

extracted_requirements.title: Electronic Expansion Valve (EXV) Positioning Steps
extracted_requirements.description: The EXV stepper motor shall modulate across 500 discrete steps with zero loss of synchronization from -30°C to +85°C.

extracted_requirements.title: Coolant Circuit Maximum Operating Pressure
extracted_requirements.description: The battery cooling loop components shall maintain zero leakage under maximum continuous operating pressure of 2.50 bar.

extracted_requirements.title: PTC Heater Ramp Rate to Rated Power
extracted_requirements.description: The high-voltage PTC cabin heater shall reach 90% of rated 6.0 kW thermal power within 15.0 seconds from cold start.

extracted_requirements.title: Coolant Degassing and Air Bubble Detection
extracted_requirements.description: The thermal controller shall detect coolant air entrainment > 5% volume fraction and trigger a de-aeration purge cycle within 30 seconds.

extracted_requirements.title: Refrigerant Pressure Relief Valve Burst Pressure
extracted_requirements.description: The R1234yf refrigerant circuit mechanical relief valve shall burst at 32.0 bar ± 1.5 bar to prevent condenser over-pressurization.

extracted_requirements.title: Cabin Thermal Comfort Model (PMV/PPD)
extracted_requirements.description: The climate control algorithm shall maintain cabin Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) within ±0.5 under steady-state cruising.

extracted_requirements.title: Electric Water Pump Dry-Run Protection Response
extracted_requirements.description: If coolant flow is lost (dry run), the electric water pump shall detect cavitation and stop motor rotation within 500 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: CAN-FD Dual Bitrate Transmission Rate
extracted_requirements.description: The powertrain CAN-FD node shall transmit with 500.0 kbps nominal arbitration bitrate and 5.0 Mbps data phase bitrate.

extracted_requirements.title: CAN Bus-Off Recovery State Machine Timing
extracted_requirements.description: Following a bus-off condition, the CAN controller shall enter recovery and resume message transmission within 100 ms ± 10 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: CAN-FD End-to-End (E2E) Profile 01 Checksum & Counter
extracted_requirements.description: All safety-critical CAN-FD messages shall implement AUTOSAR E2E Profile 01 with 8-bit CRC and 4-bit alive counter across all 16 transmission IDs.

extracted_requirements.title: 100Base-T1 Automotive Ethernet Bit Error Rate (BER)
extracted_requirements.description: The 100Base-T1 Ethernet PHY shall maintain Bit Error Rate < 10^-10 under full 100 Mbps throughput over 15 meters unshielded twisted pair.

extracted_requirements.title: CAN Transceiver Common Mode Bus Voltage Tolerance
extracted_requirements.description: CAN-FD transceivers shall operate without communication errors under ground offset / common-mode shift of ±12.0 V DC.

extracted_requirements.title: Ethernet SOME/IP Message Transmission Latency
extracted_requirements.description: High-priority SOME/IP cyclic sensor data packets shall be transmitted over Ethernet with end-to-end latency <= 1.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: LIN Bus Sleep Mode Quiescent Current Consumption
extracted_requirements.description: When LIN bus master sends go-to-sleep command, total LIN slave transceiver quiescent current shall drop below 15.0 µA within 50 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: CAN Network Management (Autosar NM) Ring Synchronization
extracted_requirements.description: During network sleep negotiation, all nodes shall synchronize sleep state and enter low power mode within 250 ms of NM timeout.

extracted_requirements.title: gPTP (IEEE 802.1AS) Time Synchronization Jitter
extracted_requirements.description: The Ethernet audio-video bridging (AVB) clock master shall maintain gPTP time synchronization across all nodes with jitter < 1.0 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: TCP/IP Stack Socket Resource Allocation
extracted_requirements.description: The embedded TCP/IP stack shall support at least 8 concurrent TCP socket connections without heap memory fragmentation.

extracted_requirements.title: UDS Diagnostic Session Control P2 Server Timing
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU diagnostic server shall respond to UDS Service 0x10 requests with P2_server response time <= 50.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic Fault Code Snapshot Freeze Frame Storage
extracted_requirements.description: Upon confirmation of a continuous fault, the ECU shall store a freeze frame containing vehicle speed, pack voltage, and timestamp within 20 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: UDS Security Access Seed-Key Authentication
extracted_requirements.description: UDS Security Access (0x27) shall require 256-bit ECDSA seed-key authentication for Level 0x01 (Reprogramming) and Level 0x03 (Engineering Calibration).

extracted_requirements.title: Firmware OTA Dual-Bank A/B Rollback Recovery
extracted_requirements.description: In the event of corrupted firmware flash payload, the bootloader shall roll back to Bank A and boot golden image in less than 3.0 seconds.

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic Service Port Authentication Requirement
extracted_requirements.description: All UDS diagnostic service sessions accessing ECU memory (0x23, 0x3D) shall require authenticated cryptographic credentials.

extracted_requirements.title: ECU Flash Reprogramming Erase & Write Throughput
extracted_requirements.description: The flash bootloader shall achieve a sustained firmware download and write throughput of at least 80.0 kB/s over UDS Service 0x36.

extracted_requirements.title: RoutineControl (0x31) Actuator Self-Test Timeout
extracted_requirements.description: UDS RoutineControl (0x31) for contactor welded detection self-test shall complete and return results within 5.0 seconds ± 100 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: UDS TesterPresent (0x3E) S3 Timer Expiration Recovery
extracted_requirements.description: If TesterPresent message is not received within S3_server timer (5.0 s), ECU shall exit extended diagnostic session and revert to default session.

extracted_requirements.title: Non-Volatile Memory (NVRAM) Wear-Leveling Endurance
extracted_requirements.description: The NVRAM storage subsystem shall support 100,000 DTC write cycles over vehicle lifetime without sector corruption.

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic Response On Sub-Function Not Supported (NRC 0x12)
extracted_requirements.description: When an unsupported sub-function is requested, the ECU shall respond with Negative Response Code 0x12 within P2_server time.

extracted_requirements.title: External Window Watchdog Challenge-Response Timeout
extracted_requirements.description: The safety microcontroller shall service the external hardware window watchdog via SPI challenge-response every 15.0 ms ± 2.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Core Voltage Brownout Detection & Safe State Transition
extracted_requirements.description: If MCU internal core voltage drops below 3.00 V DC, the power management IC shall assert RESET and enter safe state in less than 5.0 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: Lockstep Dual-Core MCU Redundancy Fault Injection
extracted_requirements.description: Dual-core lockstep processor shall detect single-bit CPU core divergence and assert safety alarm within 2 clock cycles across both Core 0 and Core 1.

extracted_requirements.title: Safety-Related ADC Redundant Cross-Check Discrepancy
extracted_requirements.description: Redundant ADC channels measuring pack voltage shall cross-check readings every 10 ms and assert fault if delta exceeds 1.5% for > 50 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Fault Reaction Time to Safe State for Overcurrent
extracted_requirements.description: The safety mechanism shall transition the traction drive to safe torque off (STO) within 10.0 ms of overcurrent detection.

extracted_requirements.title: Microcontroller Flash Memory ECC Single-Bit Correction
extracted_requirements.description: Flash memory controller shall correct single-bit errors on-the-fly and detect double-bit errors, raising non-maskable interrupt within 100 ns.

extracted_requirements.title: Plausibility Check on Dual Throttle Pedal Position Sensors
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall compare Sensor 1 and Sensor 2 throttle position voltages and enter limp-home mode if mismatch exceeds 5.0% for > 100 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Hardware Built-In Self-Test (BIST) Startup Execution Time
extracted_requirements.description: Upon power-on, the MCU logic BIST (LBIST) and memory BIST (MBIST) shall execute and complete within 50.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic Coverage (DC) for ASIL-D ISO 26262 Compliance
extracted_requirements.description: The safety architecture shall achieve Single-Point Fault Metric (SPFM) >= 99.0% and Latent Fault Metric (LFM) >= 90.0%.

extracted_requirements.title: Clock Monitor Oscillator Frequency Drift Detection
extracted_requirements.description: The internal clock monitoring unit shall detect external crystal oscillator frequency drift > ±5.0% and switch to internal PLL in < 10 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: Secure Boot Cryptographic Verification Latency
extracted_requirements.description: The Hardware Security Module (HSM) shall verify RSA-3072 firmware signature during secure boot in less than 150.0 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: AUTOSAR SecOC AES-128 CMAC Generation Time
extracted_requirements.description: The HSM crypto engine shall generate AES-128 CMAC authentication tag for CAN-FD messages in less than 50.0 µs.

extracted_requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Storage Hardware Isolation
extracted_requirements.description: All symmetric (AES) and asymmetric (ECC/RSA) root cryptographic keys shall be stored in dedicated HSM isolated flash with anti-tamper zeroization.

extracted_requirements.title: Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Rate Limiting
extracted_requirements.description: The in-vehicle IDS shall detect CAN bus message injection rate anomalies and throttle suspicious frames within 50.0 ms across all 4 CAN buses.

conditions.description: Anomaly detection and frame throttling latency

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic JTAG / Debug Port Permanent Locking
extracted_requirements.description: Production ECU hardware shall permanently disable and lock JTAG and SWD hardware debug interfaces via internal e-fuses.

extracted_requirements.title: True Random Number Generator Entropy Throughput
extracted_requirements.description: The hardware TRNG shall generate cryptographically secure entropy at a minimum throughput of 500.0 kbps for session key derivation.

extracted_requirements.title: Diagnostic Certificate Revocation List Verification
extracted_requirements.description: When verifying diagnostic client X.509 certificate, the ECU shall check CRL validity and reject expired or revoked certificates within 200 ms.

extracted_requirements.title: Side-Channel Attack DPA / SPA Resistance
extracted_requirements.description: The crypto engine shall incorporate differential power analysis (DPA) countermeasures with signal-to-noise ratio < 0.05 during AES encryption.

extracted_requirements.title: Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment Residual Risk Score
extracted_requirements.description: Per ISO 21434, all identified vehicle cybersecurity threat scenarios shall have residual risk rating reduced to CAL-2 or lower.

conditions.description: Maximum allowed residual Cybersecurity Assurance Level

extracted_requirements.title: Secure Logging of Security Events
extracted_requirements.description: The cybersecurity audit log shall record all unauthorized access attempts in tamper-evident append-only flash memory.

extracted_requirements.title: CISPR 25 Class 4 Radiated Emissions Margin
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall comply with CISPR 25 Class 4 radiated emissions limits from 150.0 kHz to 2.50 GHz with at least 6.0 dB margin.

extracted_requirements.title: ISO 16750-2 Jump Start Overvoltage Withstand
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall withstand jump-start reverse voltage and overvoltage of 26.0 V DC for 60.0 seconds without degradation.

extracted_requirements.title: 3-Axis Random Vibration Endurance Profile (ISO 16750-3)
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU enclosure shall withstand random vibration of 2.50 g RMS across X, Y, and Z axes for 8.0 hours per axis from 10 Hz to 2000 Hz.

extracted_requirements.title: Thermal Shock Cycling With Fast Transition (-40°C to +85°C)
extracted_requirements.description: The unit shall withstand 500 thermal shock cycles from -40.0°C to +85.0°C with transition time < 30 seconds and 30 min dwell time.

extracted_requirements.title: IP Ingress Protection Enclosure Rating
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU housing and electrical connectors shall achieve ingress protection rating of IP67 (dust tight and waterproof under 1 meter submersion for 30 min).

extracted_requirements.title: ISO 7637-2 Pulse 3a / 3b Fast Transient Immunity
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall maintain normal operation (Class A) during ISO 7637-2 fast transient pulses 3a (-150 V) and 3b (+100 V).

extracted_requirements.title: Salt Spray Corrosion Resistance (ISO 9227)
extracted_requirements.description: The metal enclosure and mounting brackets shall withstand 96 hours of neutral salt spray (NSS 5% NaCl at 35°C) without blistering or rust.

extracted_requirements.title: High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) Reliability Test
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall operate continuously under electrical load at +85.0°C ambient temperature for 1000 hours with zero parametric failure.

extracted_requirements.title: Damp Heat Steady State Cyclic Humidity (ISO 16750-4)
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall operate without insulation breakdown under 95% Relative Humidity at +40.0°C for 21 days.

extracted_requirements.title: Mechanical Shock Half-Sine Pulse Profile
extracted_requirements.description: The ECU shall survive 30 g half-sine mechanical shock pulses of 11.0 ms duration across all 6 spatial directions (±X, ±Y, ±Z).
